description: XSD regex category escape \p{L} (common in IETF modules). Patterns are XSD regexes, not host-language regexes.

xfail.python: pattern goes straight to re.fullmatch; '\p' is a bad escape, so validation raises re.error

xfail.ts: pattern compiled as new RegExp without the u flag, so \p{L} matches a literal 'p{L}' and valid letters are rejected
